The product

See the work itself, not an illustration.

Screens from the OrgVia web app, shown with fictional demo records. Pick a view to look at it properly.

People directory with headcount summary, filters and a paginated employee table.

Admin dashboard: attendance breakdown, check-in panel, pending actions and recent activity.

CSV import for adding many employees at once.

HR work is mostly handoffs. Someone joins, someone approves, someone pays. OrgVia keeps the record they all work from.

When employee data sits in a spreadsheet, attendance in another tool and approvals in an inbox, every handoff costs a search. OrgVia puts the people record at the centre and builds the HR workflows around it.

Managers see their own teams. HR sees the organization. Administrators configure how the workspace is structured. The same data, shown to each person according to role.

Questions

What teams ask first.

More answers in the help centre.

What is OrgVia?

OrgVia is a web-based, multi-tenant HRMS (human resource management system). It keeps employee records, the organization chart, attendance, leave, payroll workflows, recruitment, onboarding and performance in one workspace, with access set by role.

Who is OrgVia for?

HR teams and administrators at organizations that want their people records and HR workflows in one place, and the managers and employees who work with them. A demo is the quickest way to judge whether the fit is right for your team size and process.

Which HR workflows does OrgVia support?

Employee records and documents, organization chart, attendance and clock-in, leave policies and approvals, payroll configuration and payslips, recruitment, onboarding, performance reviews, compliance tracking and support tickets. Modules are switched on per organization, so what you see depends on the setup agreed with your administrator.

How do I request a demo?

Use the demo request form with your organization, team size and what you want to see. The request goes to the OrgVia team, who reply to the work email you provide.

What does OrgVia cost?

Pricing is agreed with each organization rather than listed publicly. See Pricing for how that conversation works.
